name: Temple of the Lizardmen 4
summary: Temple of the Lizardmen 4 is the fourth entry in the Temple of the Lizardmen series of mods. This entry was intended to combine the more action packed style of Lizardmen 2 with the more atmospheric approach of the third title, with the goal of creating an invigorating experience for the player
